_comment: Copy this file to profile.json (gitignored), fill it in, then load it via the Tampermonkey menu command 'Set autofill profile' (paste the JSON in). Leave any field blank/empty to skip autofilling it rather than fill a guess.
_eeo_comment: EEO/voluntary self-ID fields are almost always optional on real applications. Leave these blank to skip them entirely (recommended) rather than have the script guess an answer on your behalf.
